description: Predict non-overlapping EEE datastore metrics across explicitly labeled model parameter scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are Accuracy, Average caption length, CapArena-Auto Score (avg), CapArena-Auto Score (vs CogVLM-19B), CapArena-Auto Score (vs GPT-4o), CapArena-Auto Score (vs MiniCPM-8B), and 5 more.
